2607.02255.title: AgenticSTS: A Bounded-Memory Testbed for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
2607.02255.paper_summary: Memory for a long-horizon LLM agent is a contract about what each future decision is allowed to see. The simplest contract appends past observations, tool calls, and reflections to every prompt, which makes prior context easy to access but also turns it into a jumbled mixture in which the effect of any single memory component is hard to isolate. We introduce and instrument an alternative bounded contract: every decision is made from a fresh user message assembled by typed retrieval, with no raw cross-decision transcript appended. The prompt thus stays bounded across runs of any length, and any single layer can be ablated in isolation. We instantiate the contract in Slay the Spire 2, a closed-rule stochastic deck-building game whose runs require hundreds of tactical and strategic decisions. A public online benchmark of frontier LLMs on the same game reports zero wins at the lowest difficulty across five configurations, and the developer-reported human win rate at the same difficulty is 16%; the task is hard but not saturated. Within our harness, a fixed-A0 ablation shows the largest observed difference when triggered strategic skills are enabled: the no-store baseline wins 3/10 games and adding the skill layer 6/10. At this sample size the comparison is directional rather than statistically decisive (Fisher exact p\approx0.37); a cross-backbone probe and public accumulating-context baselines are reported as operational comparisons rather than controlled tests of the contract variable itself. We release a reproducible testbed: 298 completed trajectories with condition tags, frozen memory/skill snapshots, prompt records, and analysis scripts -- an agent design and a validated, reusable methodology for studying how explicit memory layers shape long-horizon LLM-agent decisions.
2607.02255.paper_summary_zh: 記憶對於長期視野的 LLM 代理來說是一種關於每個未來決策可以看到什麼的契約。最簡單的契約是在每個提示中附加過去的觀察、工具調用和反思，這使得先前的上下文容易訪問，但也將其轉變為一種混亂的混合，難以孤立任何單一記憶組件的影響。我們介紹並實施了一種替代的有界契約：每個決策都是從一條新用戶消息中組裝而成，通過類型檢索進行，沒有附加任何原始的跨決策記錄。因此，提示在任何長度的運行中保持有界，並且可以單獨消除任何單一層。我們在《Slay the Spire 2》中實現了這一契約，這是一款封閉規則的隨機卡牌構建遊戲，其運行需要數百個戰術和戰略決策。針對同一遊戲的前沿 LLM 的公共在線基準報告在最低難度下五種配置中均無勝利，而開發者報告的相同難度的人類勝率為 16%；這項任務難度較大，但並未飽和。在我們的測試環境中，固定的 A0 消除在觸發的戰略技能啟用時顯示出最大的觀察差異：無存儲基線贏得 3/10 場比賽，而添加技能層則贏得 6/10 場。在這個樣本大小下，這一比較是方向性的，而非統計上決定性的（Fisher 精確 p\approx0.37）；交叉骨架探針和公共累積上下文基線被報告為操作性比較，而非對契約變數本身的控制測試。我們發布了一個可重現的測試平台：298 條完成的軌跡，帶有條件標籤、凍結的記憶/技能快照、提示記錄和分析腳本——一種代理設計和經過驗證的可重用方法論，用於研究明確記憶層如何塑造長期視野的 LLM 代理決策。
